headline: INFLATION SHOCK Sends Gold Below $4,550 — Rate Cut Odds Collapse, Fed Hike Now On the Table
snippet: Gold fell to $4,542 on May 18 — its lowest since late March — after US CPI printed at 3.8%, the hottest reading since 2023. Rate-cut expectations have been wiped out entirely, with money markets now pricing a 50% chance of a December Fed hike. ANZ Group analysts warned that higher yields and a stronger dollar will keep near-term pressure on the metal.

headline: SILVER HOLDS $77 Despite Rate Hike Fears — Sixth-Year Supply Deficit and Solar Demand Anchor the Metal
snippet: Silver steadied at $77.54 on May 18 with the gold/silver ratio compressing to 58.9:1 as industrial demand from solar PV, EVs, and data centre power infrastructure continues to underpin prices. Six consecutive annual supply deficits have drawn down an estimated 762 million oz from above-ground inventories since 2021 — roughly an entire year of global mine output.

headline: CHINA RARE EARTH "TRUCE" Is a Mirage — Heavy REE Exports Still Down 50%, Yttrium Up 140x for Western Buyers
snippet: Despite diplomatic rhetoric, customs data through May 16 shows China's heavy rare earth shipments remain roughly half of pre-restriction levels. Yttrium oxide has surged more than 140x its pre-control price for ex-China buyers, while dysprosium and terbium — critical for EV motors and military systems — command 4–5x Chinese domestic reference prices in Western markets.

headline: EQUINOX BUYS ORLA for $5.1B — $18.5B North American Gold Major to Produce 1 Million oz/Year Across 6 Mines
snippet: Equinox Gold and Orla Mining announced a stock-and-cash combination on May 13 creating a $18.5B market cap senior producer running six mines across Canada, the US, Nicaragua, and Mexico. Equinox CEO Darren Hall outlined an organic growth path to nearly 2 million oz annually from a current base of 1 million oz, with shareholder votes scheduled for July.

headline: ZIJIN'S C$5.5B Allied Gold Takeover On Track for May 29 Close — Three African Open-Pit Gold Mines in the Deal
snippet: Zijin Gold International's all-cash C$5.5B acquisition of Allied Gold (TSX: AAUC) is progressing through final regulatory approvals toward a May 29 outside close date. The deal at C$44/share — a 27% premium to the 30-day VWAP — adds the Sadiola mine in Mali, the Bonikro-Agbaou complex in Côte d'Ivoire, and the Kurmuk mine in Ethiopia to Zijin's growing portfolio.

headline: LUNAHUASI STUNS With 1,740 g/t Gold in 2m — NGEx Minerals Wraps Phase 4 at Argentina Copper-Gold-Silver Project
snippet: NGEx Minerals (TSX: NGEX) reported a Phase 4 highlight of 17.3m at 207.79 g/t Au from Lunahuasi in San Juan, Argentina, including a 2m section grading 1,740 g/t Au — grades comparable to the world's highest-grade gold-only deposits. The 27,318m Phase 4 program is now complete with assays from the final 12 holes still pending.

headline: TOMBSTONE DELIVERS — Aztec Minerals Extends Arizona Oxide Gold-Silver Zone Past 1 km With 2.31 g/t Au Over 27.4m
snippet: Aztec Minerals (TSXV: AZT) reported five new reverse-circulation holes from its Tombstone project in southeastern Arizona, with a best intercept of 2.31 g/t Au and 43.23 g/t Ag over 27.4m, within a broader 66.9m zone at 1.05 g/t Au. Step-out drilling has extended the shallow oxide mineralized trend westward and northward past the 1 km mark.

headline: URANIUM EXPLORER Kicks Off 100,000 ft Season at Kaycee ISR — Powder River Basin Season Underway
snippet: Premier American Uranium commenced a 100,000 ft 2026 exploration drill program at its Kaycee ISR project in Wyoming's Powder River Basin, targeting the Outpost (~33,000 ft) and Rustler (~51,000 ft) areas to infill between mineralized channels and evaluate ISR-amenable uranium resources. Spot uranium holds near $86/lb while term contracts are reportedly settling at $150/lb.

headline: LARGEST EVER DRILL PROGRAM at NAK — American Eagle Gold Turns 3 Rigs on 50,000m BC Copper-Gold Porphyry
snippet: American Eagle Gold (TSXV: AEG) has two diamond drill rigs turning at its NAK copper-gold porphyry in central BC with a third mobilizing around May 25, targeting over 50,000m in a 2026–2027 season. Phase 1 is 23,000m across 32 holes designed to support a maiden NI 43-101 resource estimate, fully funded from existing cash.

headline: MP MATERIALS Posts Record Q1 — NdPr Oxide Output Up 63%, Magnetics Revenue $21M as US Rare Earth Chain Advances
snippet: MP Materials (NYSE: MP) reported record Q1 2026 NdPr oxide production of 917 metric tons — up 63% year-over-year — with total revenue of $132.9M, a 49% increase. The company broke ground on a 10x magnetics capacity expansion and expects its heavy rare earth separation circuit to begin commissioning in Q2.

headline: COPPER TARIFF CLOCK Ticking — US Commerce to Recommend 25%+ Levy by June, Traders Pricing In Volatility
snippet: Goldman Sachs' base case calls for a 25%+ US tariff on refined copper imports following a Commerce Secretary recommendation expected by June 2026. Copper fell 4.8% on May 15 to near $6.25/lb before stabilizing; global visible copper inventory outside the US has swelled to nearly 1.5 million tonnes as LME stockpiles build ahead of a potential tariff shock.

headline: ENERGY STORAGE BOOM Forces a Rethink on Lithium — Grid Batteries to Consume 31% of Supply in 2026, Up from 23%
snippet: A surge in grid-scale battery storage installations — forecast to hit 359 GWh globally in 2026 versus 273 GWh in 2025 — is reshaping lithium demand projections. Energy storage's share of total lithium consumption is rising from 23% to 31% in a single year, with China alone adding 182 GWh, adding a structural new demand floor beneath beaten-down lithium prices.

headline: MINERS TRADING at a 16% DISCOUNT to Gold's January Peak — Record Margins Signal the Re-Rating Is Overdue
snippet: The GDM gold miners index is up roughly 50% year-to-date while gold itself sits 16% below its January record high of $5,602, creating unusual upside leverage for producers running all-in costs well below $2,000/oz. Multiple analysts argue that M&A acceleration — exemplified by the Equinox-Orla and Zijin-Allied deals — is the catalyst that forces a sector re-rating.
